definitions.explanation: The fall or capture of a fortified position, city, or stronghold to an opposing force. Also used figuratively for yielding to persuasion or temptation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{陥落|かんらく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{首都|しゅと}→首都：03224_shuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{陥落|かんらく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{終結|しゅうけつ}→終結：13851_shuuketsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The war ended with the fall of the capital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{包囲戦|ほういせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、⟦{要塞|ようさい}→要塞：14157_yousai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ついに{陥落|かんらく}し、⟦{守備|しゅび}→守備：15509_shubi⟧⟦{兵|へい}→兵：29510_hei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{降伏|こうふく}した→降伏する：20577_koufukusuru⟧。
examples.english: After a long siege, the fortress finally fell, and the defenders surrendered.

notes:
USAGE:
{陥落|かんらく} is primarily a military and historical term for the fall of a fortified position. It is also used figuratively — for example, someone "falling" to persuasion ({口説|くど}き{落|お}とす) may be described as {陥落|かんらく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{陥落|かんらく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (the castle falls)
- ⟦{首都|しゅと}→首都：03224_shuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{陥落|かんらく} (the fall of the capital)
- ⟦{要塞|ようさい}→要塞：14157_yousai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{陥落|かんらく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (the fortress falls)
- {陥落|かんらく}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧ (to capture; to cause to fall)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {陥落|かんらく}: fall of a fortress/city (military defeat)
- ⟦{降伏|こうふく}→降伏：03770_koufuku⟧: surrender (formally giving up)
- {落城|らくじょう}: fall of a castle (more specific to castles)
